feature_contract.goal: Repair the complete central sun lens-flare draw owner so nested or VR-disabled original call edges never leak ownership and the direct world sun consumes no stale pending Draw; keep all exterior discs and SkyGlow identical.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original central EXE 0xD3A5..0xD3AA source and independent 0xC993 actual sun draw. Exclude EXE 0xCABE projected outer rings, SceneEffect Z-near, GOAL/+TIME, rank, menus, world/road/vehicle, SkyGlow, DX11 and DXVK.
trace_stages: Original EXE 0xD3A5/0xD3AA paired sun parent, 0x570002 object and exact 0xC993 actual DrawObjectAlpha_Internal source, versus 0xCABE outer rings.
GameSemantic direct exact WorldBillboard draw temporarily removes stale NextDrawScope, restores prior token and saves/restores queue semantic while preserving non-queue parent depth.
R33 physical Draw consumes correct direct scope, R30 WVP/semantic per-eye pass routes the world sun; protected outer ProjectedScreenEffect2D and SkyGlow remain unchanged in compositor.
subcomponents: Balance every original sun enter/leave across disabled VR, nested call, and live SpriteNode queue without a premature outer-scope restore or inherited stale owner.
Guard 0xC993 by verified active parent depth, sun object identity, non-queue and VR mode; isolate pending HUD/world one-shot semantic only for the exact sun, preserving its later owner.

Reject destructive mutation of depth accounting, pending token isolation, object identity and outer-ring callsite; require exact-SHA Win32 host/game/package + Domain/Impact Gates before declaring build-verified.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only 0x570002 during balanced non-queue D3A5/0xD3AA parent gets WorldBillboard stereo provenance, with unrelated pending Draw consumed by its own later owner.
Every nested skipped entry has a matching leave; VR-off and queue paths preserve original; outer CABE discs, SkyGlow, scene effects, and world matrices are not changed.
Destructive source mutants fail and full exact SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, EXE HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact succeed; HMD optical correctness stays UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User Quest3 visual feedback 2026-10-14: central flare doubled while surrounding 3-4 rings remain acceptable; canonical 0xD3A5/0xD3AA and exact C993 disassembly source exists.
diagnosis.root_cause: Parent-entry guard previously incremented depth only for enabled non-queue paths while every leave decremented; a skipped nested call can pop active outer owner. Direct actual sun constructor also did not isolate a pending one-shot Draw, so prior world/HUD provenance can override central stereo.
source_trace: 0xD3A5 callsite and 0xD3AA leave on original sub_40C980 source, independent of outer 0xCABE
0xC993 direct DrawObjectAlpha_Internal receives 0x570002 with WorldBillboard via exact producer RAII and pending token preservation
R33 ConsumeForDraw -> R30 screen/world classification -> DX9Ex per-eye draw -> OpenXR host stereo; no outer CABE modifications
alternatives_rejected: Do not apply global lens disparity scalar or promote outer CABE rings to world; HMD reported outer rings acceptable.
Do not mark flat ScreenHud for central world source; that removes finite parallax and is known wrong.
Do not suppress one of the original alpha draw calls or alter SkyGlow/near plane to hide double image.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: WorldBillboard central owner only after exact parent/object proof, protected original per-eye WVP; outer rings retain ProjectedScreenEffect2D.
